extracted.name: Best Peanut Sauce
extracted.description: This spicy peanut sauce can be whipped up in an instant and makes a great addition to many Chinese and Thai recipes.
instruction_lines: In a small bowl, stir together peanut butter, soy sauce, sugar, hot pepper sauce and garlic until well mixed. Gradually stir in water until texture is smooth and creamy.
